shape._comment: KR Solidarity v6.1 — Semantic Shape Library. All tokens emit as --shape-{name} CSS vars. Legacy tokens preserved for compat.

md.$description: Neutral. M3: Medium. BANNED as uniform 4-corner (Institutional Squelch).

full.$description: Pill. Use instead of 50%. NEVER border-radius:50%.

shape._comment_v61: === v6.1 CORE SHAPE LIBRARY (KR semantic names) ===

blockRiot01.$description: Tier:Core UI. Strike (base), Scaffold (immutable). Composed: md xs md xs. CSS: --shape-blockRiot01

blockRiot02.$description: Tier:Core UI. Strike (active/hover), March (dropdown). Composed: xl sm lg xs. CSS: --shape-blockRiot02

blockRiot03.$description: Tier:Core UI. Strike (CTA base). Corner-dominant asymmetry. Composed: xxl xs xs xs. CSS: --shape-blockRiot03

blockRiot03-pressed.$description: Morph: blockRiot03 on press (= blockRiot02). CSS: --shape-blockRiot03-pressed

blockRiot03-loading.$description: Morph: blockRiot03 loading state (pill collapse). CSS: --shape-blockRiot03-loading

pillMarch01.$description: Tier:Core UI. March (pill variant), Strike (pill). Full pill — use radius.full. NEVER 50%. CSS: --shape-pillMarch01

marchSurge01.$description: Tier:Core UI. March (open/active morph). Composed: xl md lg xxl. CSS: --shape-marchSurge01

alertShard01.$description: Tier:Core UI. Strike (selected/error/alert state). Asymmetric shard. CSS: --shape-alertShard01

scaffoldFrame01.$description: Tier:Core UI. Scaffold archetype (inputs, structural elements). IMMUTABLE — never morphs. CSS: --shape-scaffoldFrame01

scaffoldFrame01-focus.$description: Morph: scaffoldFrame01 focus (unchanged — Scaffold invariance). CSS: --shape-scaffoldFrame01-focus

megaphoneCut01.$description: Tier:Core UI. Megaphone archetype (modal base). Organic % radii. CSS: --shape-megaphoneCut01

placardTorn01.$description: Tier:Core UI. Placard archetype (content containers). Organic % radii. CSS: --shape-placardTorn01

placardTorn01-selected.$description: Morph: placardTorn01 selected state (= blockRiot02). CSS: --shape-placardTorn01-selected

substrateTile01.$description: Tier:Decorative. Substrate ambient morph. BANNED outside Substrate/hero whitelist. CSS: --shape-substrateTile01

substrateTile02.$description: Tier:Decorative. Substrate base (background canvases, hero frames). BANNED outside whitelist. CSS: --shape-substrateTile02

tearBanner01.$description: Tier:Tension. Right-corner aggressive tear. Scroll-triggered reveals. CSS: --shape-tearBanner01

brickWall01.$description: Tier:Tension. Completely flat. Hard construction. Structural dividers, data tables. CSS: --shape-brickWall01

archetypes._comment: KR Solidarity v6.1 Semantic Action Archetypes — shape palette + motion coupling. Ref: archetypes.ts

shape.pressed.$description: pill w/ side notch on press

elevation1Strike.$description: Strike depth for small interactive elements (chips, small buttons).

elevation2Placard.$description: Placard depth for default cards and panels.

elevation3HoverLift.$description: Hover/active lift. Pair with viscous transition.

inkOffset.$description: Hard-edge optimism accent for primary CTAs and key poster-like elements.

solidarityBleed.$description: Rage glow for destructive/urgent emphasis. Keep subtle; avoid accessibility issues.

viscousBreezeTransition.$description: Shadows ooze into place; use on elevation changes and interactive states.

motifs.$description: Motif system designed for icon-scale clarity and street-kr-dark screenprint aesthetic. No crowns. No bureaucratic forms, passports, IDs, border gates. First Nations solidarity appears only in situ (placards/posters), without aesthetic appropriation.

$value: Naarm place motifs: laneway brick, wheat-paste posters, tram silhouette
Devotional anchor: Shiva (statue-inspired Nataraja presence) + Option A icon: trishula + damru (icon-scale)
Resistance lineage: Tipu Sultan portrait (green turban, tiger motifs), Bhagat Singh portrait (profile + hat + martyr halo) with Latin-script 'INQUILAB ZINDABAD'
sources.$description: Reference motifs used in the moodboard and brand direction.

slogans.$description: English-only street-poster voice. Use sparingly; avoid slogan wallpaper.

antiSlopProtocol.$description: Explicit bans and requirements to preserve cultural safety, legibility, and non-tokenistic representation.

$value: Passports, visas, ID cards, border gates, government forms, bureaucratic aesthetics
Aboriginal art imitation (dot painting, invented 'Aboriginal-style' patterns, sacred motif appropriation)
Using Aboriginal flag colors as general decoration (allowed only in situ on placards/posters)
Symmetrical geometric layouts as the dominant structure
Static single-weight fonts; non-variable font usage
Overuse of slogans across screens/tiles (slogan wallpaper)
Mixing devotional (Shiva) and First Nations solidarity into a single composite motif
Hardcoded border-radius px values in component code (use --sys-radius-* or --sys-shape-* tokens)
Uniform 4-corner radius (border-radius: 8px all corners) — the Institutional Squelch
shape.blob* tokens outside Substrate archetype without explicit whitelist exception
Scaffold archetype elements that morph on interaction (Scaffold is immutable)
Old deprecated archetype names in code or docs: Seed, Pebble, Lens, Jar, Cabinet (use Strike/March/Megaphone/Placard/Scaffold/Substrate)
banned.$description: Hard bans. Any violation is a design-system failure.

$value: Dark-only Solidarity mode on charcoal base
Variable fonts with wght 100–900, wdth 75–125, opsz 8–144
Extreme variable contrast: enforce 9× weight ratio (100 vs 900) and 6× size ratio (12px vs 72px+)
M3 Expressive motion curve for typographic transitions: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)
Icon-scale motifs must be recognizable at 24px
Wheat-paste/brick/paint textures remain background-only; foreground UI retains legibility
First Nations solidarity appears only in situ via placards/posters/acknowledgment text
